verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents a self-hosted Edge Proxy that runs an instance of the Flagsmith Engine close to your servers, and server-side SDKs connect to it. That satisfies the story's edge/relay-layer path for flag evaluation. However, the docs frame it as 'close to your servers' rather than close to end users, and only server-side SDK connections are evidenced. Missing for 10: evaluation in CDN workers (e.g., Cloudflare/Vercel edge runtimes), documented client-side/end-user proximity, depth on proxy deployment and latency characteristics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
